transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, uh... well, I guess I came in because... I just haven't been myself. 

Most days I wake up and there's just this... heavy feeling. Like a hollow feeling right here in my chest. I don't really know how to explain it well. It just feels like the old Ruben—the guy who could talk to anybody and actually enjoy his day—is just... gone. So, I'm here.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... a while. I'd say... about eight months. Give or take. 

It kind of started when... well, things just changed at work. We got a new regional manager and he just... started coming down on me. Taking away my accounts. Accounts I’d handled for years, just... gone. So... yeah. Since around then, I guess.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

No. Not really. I used to... I don't know, I used to bowl. Work in the garden. Take my wife to those gallery shows she likes, or go dancing. But... I don't do any of that now. I just sit there and... make excuses, mostly. None of it really feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself or wished you were dead since you started feeling this way?

I... I don't know if I'd call it... harming myself. But... 

Sometimes I just think... maybe it would be easier. For everyone. If I just... didn't wake up. My wife, the kids... they wouldn't have to deal with... this. With me. 

It's... it scares me a bit, honestly. I don't... I don't really trust myself right now. Not the way I used to.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or the way you move?

I don't... I haven't really noticed. 

Like I said, I mostly just... sit around now. So I haven't really paid attention to how I move. Just... regular, I guess. I don't know.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?

I... I'm not really sure. 

I guess I haven't paid that much attention. I just... I don't do much. So... maybe? I don't know.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?

I... haven't really checked. 

I don't step on the scale much anymore. So... I don't think so. Probably about the same.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless about things?

I... yeah, I guess. 

I just... keep thinking I'm useless now. It feels like... all those years taking care of clients, providing for my family... like none of it counts. Just because I can't even handle my job anymore. So... yeah. I don't know.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge?

I... no, not really. 

I just feel... tired, mostly. Not really anxious. Just... kind of numb, I guess.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard any voices that others couldn't hear since you started feeling this way?
No. I... haven't had anything like that. Just... my own thoughts. No voices.
Have you had any periods in the last eight months where you felt better for a couple of months before feeling down again?
No... not really. It's just... pretty much been like this the whole time. It hasn't really let up.
Have you had any days in the past eight months where you felt completely back to normal?
No... I don't think so. I can't really remember... feeling normal. It's just all been the same.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to or do you find yourself fidgeting or restless more often?
No... I haven't really noticed anything like that. I just... I don't think so.
Have you ever felt like things are not real or that you're detached from the world around you since you started feeling this way?
No... I haven't felt like that. Things are real enough... I just... no, I don't think I've had that.
Have you ever felt like you're being controlled by an outside force or that your thoughts are not your own since you started feeling this way?
No... I haven't. It's just my own thoughts in there. Nothing like that.
Have you had any thoughts that you think are not true but believe to be true since you started feeling this way?
No... I haven't had any thoughts like that. I know what's real... I just feel bad, that's all.
Have you had any periods in the last eight months where you felt slightly better for at least two weeks before feeling down again?
No... I don't think so. It's pretty much just been... constant. No real break from it.
Have you had any periods in the last eight months where you felt significantly better for a couple of weeks or more before feeling down again?
No... like I just said, there hasn't been any break. It's... it's just been the same the whole time.
Have you had any periods in the last eight months where you felt better for at least a month before feeling down again?
No... I haven't. Like I said, it just doesn't lift. Not for a month, not for anything. It just stays.
Would you say your feelings of heaviness and numbness are mild, moderate, or severe most of the time?
I don't really know how to rate it... I guess severe. It's just bad.
